name: Specialty Wholesale Operations
audience: small specialty wholesalers and B2B distributors
topic: reorders, backorders, and account operations for specialty distributors

products.name: Account Reorder Signal
products.product: A lightweight account-level reminder that surfaces likely replenishment opportunities using prior cadence and rep judgment.
products.audience: small specialty wholesalers and B2B distributors
products.problem: Repeat customers fall outside a rep's memory when expected reorder timing varies by account, item family, season, and open inventory issue.
products.valueProposition: Creates explainable reorder review dates with account context, prior order evidence, outreach ownership, and outcome tracking.
products.topic: wholesale customer reorder reminders and account follow-up
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets wholesale reorder reminder, distributor sales follow-up, reorder cadence spreadsheet, and B2B customer reactivation searches.

products.name: Backorder Update Desk
products.product: A customer-communication queue for open order lines affected by supply delay, substitution, partial fulfillment, or changed ETA.
products.audience: small specialty wholesalers and B2B distributors
products.problem: Operations updates ETAs in one system while account reps manually reconstruct which customers need an update and what alternatives can be offered.
products.valueProposition: Connects each affected line to the latest source, customer promise, option, owner, and next-update date.
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets backorder email template, customer delay notification, wholesale order status tracker, and proactive ETA communication searches.

products.name: New Account Packet
products.product: A guided onboarding checklist for collecting wholesale account terms, contacts, tax documents, ordering preferences, and operational setup.
products.audience: small specialty wholesalers and B2B distributors
products.problem: New accounts bounce between sales, operations, and accounting because required information and approvals are collected in separate emails.
products.valueProposition: Creates one itemized packet with secure uploads, validation, internal approvals, and a clear ready-to-order state.
products.topic: wholesale customer onboarding and new account setup checklists
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets wholesale account application, distributor onboarding checklist, new customer packet, and B2B account setup workflow searches.
